name: Brand
description: Your company's look for work videos. Ships with an example palette (indigo, sky, rose, amber on slate) and Poppins: replace the colours, font and logo with your brand kit.

roles.cyan: highlight: key words, ticks, bars (a light brand colour that reads on dark footage)
roles.blue: deep anchor: your primary colour, the gradient end and the block behind white text
roles.magenta: punchline: the payoff word, the last step of a diagram
roles.amber: money and stakes: prices, savings, warnings

logo.note: Put your logo files (PNG or SVG) in styles/brand/ and list them here; never ship a placeholder logo.

rules: No colours outside this palette and its dark background.
Keep about 6% of the frame as a safe margin, and the logo's clear space free of graphics and text.
